newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Ciampi says he wants lira in ERM by yr end.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Ciampi says he wants lira in ERM by yr end.

text.p: Italian Treasury Minister Carlo Azeglio Ciampi said on Monday that he wanted the lira to return to the European Exchange Rate Mechanism (ERM) by the end of the year, RAI state television and agencies reported.

The television and ANSA news agency quoted Ciampi at a meeting of European finance ministers in Luxembourg as saying that the timing would coincide with the crucial 1997 budget being well on the way to being approved by parliament.
He said the starting point for negotiations with Italy's European partners on new central parity levels should reflect the lira's market level in recent months and weeks.
"With the return to the ERM Italy will respect the parameters set out in the Maastricht treaty," he said.
Ciampi did not give any precise dates for return to the ERM, saying merely that "it will be sought by the Italian government when it believes the conditions are right."
He added that he did not think there was "necessarily a link" between interest rates and re-entry.
